    AI Overview
    Live Nation Entertainment is primarily owned by Liberty Media Corporation, which holds roughly 30% of the company's shares as its largest shareholder. As a public company (NYSE: LYV), other major institutional investors like Vanguard and BlackRock also hold significant stakes. Liberty Media, managed by Greg Maffei, maintains it as a top asset. 
    Key Ownership and Structure Details 
    • Largest Shareholder: Liberty Media Corporation holds approximately 30.09% of Live Nation's common stock.
    • Key Individuals: Liberty Media’s Greg Maffei is Chairman, while Michael Rapino is the long-standing CEO and President of Live Nation Entertainment.
    • Institutional Ownership:
      Institutional investors, including BlackRock, Inc., hold a combined stake of about 79.5%.
    • Structure: Live Nation Entertainment was formed in 2009/2010 through the merger of Live Nation and Ticketmaster. 
    Note: In April 2026, a U.S. federal jury found that Live Nation has been operating as a monopoly in the concert promotion and ticketing industry.

    Who are the owners of Live Nation?
    Live Nation is owned by Liberty Media Corporation. Liberty Media is a media, communications, and entertainment conglomerate based in Englewood, Colorado. The company owns a variety of assets, including Sirius XM, Formula 1, and Live Nation.
